blocks.text: Ship product faster without growing the team.
We build the agents and pipes around your app, from onboarding and support to churn signals, integrations, and internal ops, so founders and engineers stay on the roadmap.
SaaS teams we built for
The stack we ship on
Engineers stopped being the bottleneck.
The bottleneck moved to orchestration. Claude Code drives the agents, MCP plugs into Stripe, Postgres, Linear, and Slack. E2B runs every tool call in a sandbox.

Onboarding that gets users to their first win
Most churn happens in the first session. We wire onboarding to product events, not generic email sequences, so users hit activation without a CSM holding their hand.
Event-driven nudges
Triggered off Segment, PostHog, or your own events. No more drip campaigns that ignore what the user already did.
Lead routing that respects PQL signals
Product-qualified leads go straight to sales. Self-serve trials get an automated path. One workflow, one source of truth.
Catch churn before the cancel email
At-risk account alerts
We watch the signals that actually predict churn, not vanity logins.
Usage drops: core feature adoption falling below your activation threshold.
Ticket spikes: repeated support requests on the same account.
Seat decay: active users on a team account shrinking month-over-month.
Health scores that route work
Every account gets a live score. CSMs focus on the accounts where intervention matters. The long tail gets automated outreach.
Support that scales without hiring
Tier-1 tickets are repetitive. We deploy agents that resolve them in your tone, escalate the rest with full context, and learn from every closed ticket.
Agents that close the easy 60%
Password resets, billing questions, integration FAQs: resolved from your docs and Stripe data. Human agents get the rest with context attached.
Self-serve that actually answers
In-app search that pulls from docs, changelog, and resolved tickets. Most users find the answer before they ever open a ticket.
Integrations and internal tools, without burning eng cycles
Every SaaS hits the same wall: customer-requested integrations, internal dashboards, ops scripts. We build them so your engineers stay on the product.
Customer-facing integrations
Salesforce, HubSpot, Notion, the Slack bot a prospect asked for. Built, deployed, and monitored without pulling a senior engineer off the roadmap.
Internal ops automations
Trial expiry handling, dunning, fraud flags, beta access flows. The stuff that lives in Stripe + Postgres + Linear, glued together by agents instead of an SDR.
Product analytics that route actions
We sit on top of Mixpanel, Amplitude, or PostHog and trigger workflows from the signals, not just dashboards nobody opens.
